d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : ek aisi shadi... jiski charcha sirph bihar hi nahin, balki pure desh men ho rahi hai.... shadi men char lakh mehmanon ke lie khane ka intjam, 150 se jyada tarah ke pakvan, deshbhar ke VIP mehman aur ghurdaur pratiyogita ke vijetaon ke lie Thar, motarsaikil aur skuti jaise shandar inam.... ji han ham bat kar rahe hain mokama ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ki.... lekin is shahi shadi ke bich ek aisi tasvir samne aaee hai, jisne logon ki utsukta aur barha di hai.... kyonki jis beti ki shadi ko yadgar banane ke lie anant sinh pani ki tarah paisa…
